Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value from target CHEMBL1938208. Join target_dictionary to assays to activities to molecule_dictionary to compound_structures. Filter to standard_type IC50, standard_relation exact equals, pchembl_value not null. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Limit 1000 rows. Do not deduplicate; keep every qualifying activity row.
